paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Bumper Canard Set is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this aerodynamic upgrade draws on BMW Motorsport GT4 race components while maintaining precise fitment for the road-going M2.

Front bumper canards play an important role in managing airflow at the front of the vehicle. By directing high-speed airflow away from the bumper corners and front wheel openings, the Alpha-N canards stabilise airflow along the body of the car and contribute to increased front-end downforce during high-speed driving.
